indicator.description: Net State Domestic Product (NSDP) of each state and union territory in â‚¹ crore, faceted by price basis. Use 'current' for share-of-national rankings or tax-base sizing; use 'constant' for state-level real growth-rate analysis. Long spliced series 1994-95 â†’ 2024-25 (31 fiscal years), stitched across MoSPI's four base-year revisions (1993-94, 1999-2000, 2004-05, 2011-12). indicator.methodology_vintage: MoSPI multi-base spliced (1993-94 / 1999-2000 / 2004-05 / 2011-12); RBI Handbook 2024-25 edition
indicator.notes: Source: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy 2024-25 edition, Tables 5 (current) and 6 (constant). Telangana (S29) starts in 2014-15 (carve-out from Andhra Pradesh). U08 (J&K) post-2019-20 is UT-only (Ladakh excluded). 2024-25 is Provisional Estimates per RBI; 2023-24 is First Revised. Cross-base growth rates not strictly comparable â€” see series_breaks.

series_breaks.note: MoSPI rebase to 2011-12 base AND switched headline aggregate from 'NSDP at factor cost' (pre-2011-12) to 'NSDP at basic prices' (2011-12 onwards). Growth rates spanning 2010-11 -> 2011-12 are not strictly comparable.

Telangana carved out of Andhra Pradesh on 2 June 2014. RBI back-projects S29 (Telangana) to 2011-12 by carving from undivided AP; pre-2014-15 S29 values are MoSPI back-estimates, not original state DES figures. S01 (residual Andhra Pradesh) is reported on the post-bifurcation footprint from 2011-12 too.
J&K reorganisation (Aug 2019): U08 series from 2019-20 onwards covers UT of Jammu & Kashmir only (Ladakh not separately reported in this RBI table).

series_spec.description: Faceted long-form NSDP series (basis âˆˆ {current, constant}); state-grain rows over fiscal years 1994-04..latest; each row carries `vintage` = base-year tag.

methodology.definition: Net State Domestic Product (NSDP) is the value of new goods and services produced within a state in a fiscal year, net of capital depreciation. Reported per state and Union Territory in INR crore, faceted by price basis (`current` = nominal sticker value; `constant` = real, base-year-deflated). Pre-2011-12 figures use 'NSDP at factor cost'; 2011-12 onwards use 'NSDP at basic prices'.
notes: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy 2024-25 edition, Tables 5 (current) and 6 (constant). Workbook stacks four base-year sections; we keep the latest-base value per (state, year, basis) and stamp the chosen base on each row's `vintage` field.
